first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so simplifying onboarding offers the strongest direct response to the current funnel problem and supports sustainable qualified revenue without immediately discounting. Verify the prior onboarding and signup results, while checking promotional-pricing evidence as the main alternative given competitive SMB pressure. Use a guarded test to monitor activation, completion, qualification, retention, and revenue quality before scaling.

final.rationale: Run a standard, segmented onboarding simplification experiment focused on improving completion and activation. The prior shortened-onboarding test improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, directly matching the current declines in completion and activation. Signup simplification also lifted SMB activation and qualified revenue, but its small retention decline warrants monitoring by segment. Do not use promotional pricing this week: although it increased short-term qualified revenue, the 12% retention loss indicates poor sustainable value. Track completion, activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, qualified revenue, and renewal-quality signals before rollout.
